hard_rules: wow-service is the only framework dependency
each valid command invokes exactly one service operation
the tool does not implement or directly call source traversal Cargo rustc process sandbox signing provider archive installer store or credential APIs
the tool accepts no arbitrary command shell script environment callback URL header provider API GitHub API upload callback or installer command
private keys tokens passwords cookies endpoints signing sockets KMS HSM vault and CI credentials never enter normal arguments config fixtures logs or results
source branch tag cwd filename latest newest previous first sole and highest version never replace exact identities
build evidence sign bundle candidate publish update manifest revoke retire and reconcile are distinct commands and effects
the tool never selects or mutates a release candidate bundle channel target or provider plan
reconcile never redispatches an unknown effect
JSON output is exact service bytes plus one LF and output failure never repeats service
the tool performs no telemetry update check background polling build signing upload or cleanup
CI may invoke the tool only after real commands and freeze evidence exist and publication remains separately authorized
the tool is excluded from the default public bundle

required_before_first_rust_implementatio: implemented and frozen E7-B service operation schemas and bytes
exact command option selector input output exit cancellation progress direct and daemon transport profiles
canonical command request result text artifact error and reconciliation vectors
credential absence path security output failure CI and one-call conformance reports
all member and bundle SHA-256 values
